title: Loyalty Make-Good Schedule for Long-Standing Pals Rewards Members, Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
*Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus benefit schedule, service recovery.*

A severe claim on a Tailwise Pharmacy fill — wrong medication or wrong strength recorded on the claimed fill, the most recent dispensed fill of the prescription — also earns a loyalty make-good, added to the dispensing-error refund. The make-good follows how long the customer has held the Pals Rewards membership, counted in whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date, as the membership record shows it, to the refund date.

## Schedule

| Claim | Whole calendar months from the membership's enrollment date to the refund date | Loyalty make-good |
|---|---|---|
| Severe | 96 or more | $5.00 |
| Severe | at least 36 but fewer than 96 | $2.50 |
| Severe | fewer than 36 | nothing |
| Severe | no membership | nothing |
| Wrong quantity or wrong label | any | nothing |

## Boundary months (hypothetical dates)

| Enrollment date | Refund date | Whole calendar months | Make-good on a severe claim |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2018-07-20 | 2026-07-20 | 96 | $5.00 |
| 2018-07-20 | 2026-07-19 | 95 | $2.50 |
| 2023-07-20 | 2026-07-20 | 36 | $2.50 |
| 2023-07-20 | 2026-07-19 | 35 | nothing |
